faq.a: Nano Banana is an AI image generation platform specializing in character consistency and AI influencer creation. It's designed for creators who need to generate the same person or character across many different scenes, outfits, and settings while maintaining a consistent look.

Leonardo.ai is popular with game developers, concept artists, and designers who need consistent visual styles across multiple images. Its fine-tuning capabilities let you train on your own images. It's also widely used for general AI image generation with 150 free daily tokens.

Leonardo.ai has character reference features and IP Adapter controls for maintaining consistency across images. It's not as specialized for AI influencer creation as Nano Banana, but works well for consistent game characters and concept art series.

Nano Banana offers a free plan with limited generations. Paid plans provide more credits and higher quality generations. It's a specialized tool — the free tier lets you test whether the character consistency meets your needs before subscribing.

faq.a: Nano Banana is Google's family of Gemini image generation and editing models, including Nano Banana 2, 2 Lite, 2.1 and Pro, accessible through the Gemini app, Google AI Studio and the Gemini API. It supports multi-turn conversational editing, character consistency, and output up to 4K.

faq.q: What is Leonardo AI best for?
faq.a: Leonardo AI is built for game developers, concept artists, and creative teams who need high-volume image and video generation across multiple models, including sketch-to-image tools, a canvas editor, and a visual API workflow that exports production-ready code.

faq.q: Which is better for character consistency across a series of images?
faq.a: Nano Banana 2.1 offers multi-turn character consistency directly through conversational editing in the Gemini app or API. Leonardo AI instead lets you train a personal AI model on your own images to maintain a consistent style or character, which suits project-based work like game asset series.

faq.q: Is Nano Banana free to use?
faq.a: Nano Banana 2 is free to use in the Gemini app with no numeric usage limits published, but Nano Banana 2.1 and the Pro redo option require a paid Google AI plan. The Gemini API has no free tier and bills per output image for all models in the family.

faq.q: Does Leonardo AI have a free plan?
faq.a: Yes, Leonardo AI's FREE plan gives 150 Fast Tokens per day with public-only creations and basic quality settings, which is enough to try the platform but limited for professional volume use.
